slides.texte_overlay:
odd things self assured
people do without thinking

they walk at their own pace

they don't speed up just because everyone around them is rushing. moving at their own calm pace shows they're completely comfortable in their own skin.

they ask what words mean

when they hear a word they don't know, they simply ask. being curious instead of pretending to understand is a quiet but very clear sign of real inner security.

they keep growing

self assured people keep learning little things every day, a strange fact or a famous painting, and that steady growth makes their confidence calm and solid.
slides.texte_sophia:
they keep growing

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something new, a strange fact or a painting. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and i feel steadier every single week.

slides.texte_overlay:
they hold eye contact

they look at people while they talk instead of at the floor. calm eye contact tells everyone they have nothing to hide and absolutely nothing to prove.

they sit comfortably

they lean back and relax in their chair instead of folding in. taking up a normal amount of space is one of the clearest signals of real, quiet confidence.
